provenance.note: Where the sediment enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer, or a place name. Its name becomes the marker's name, and on a river with no domain supplied it is also the seed the reach is walked downstream from [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]
Point-source discharge of the release itself, small against the carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]
Median grain diameter d50 of the RELEASED class - ~200 um fine sand settles within a few km, ~20 um silt mostly stays suspended (all modeled non-cohesive) [supplied on this invocation]
Concentration of the released suspended sediment; what deposits is measured against what this put in [supplied on this invocation]

Simulated physical time the run covers. The clock the run is settled on, so the deck's DURATION and every window read off it are this one number; what is long enough is the question's, and a question that knows states its own [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
Along-domain release position, 0=inflow..1=outflow; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the domain, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
Sustained wind driving a surface wind-stress term; 0 = no wind [declared scenario default]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E); only read when wind_speed_mps > 0 [declared scenario default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]

The mass the pulse released - source_q_m3s x sediment_concentration_mgl x spill_duration_s - which the deposited fraction is measured against [derived by trid3nt_server.workflows.telemac.helpers.released_mass.injected_mass_kg]
not supplied; every observed row is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published
